$schema: Performance Tip catalog. May be enriched by scripts/sync-parts.mjs.

tips.name: RF
tips.info: Rubber tip with maximum friction. Drives explosive smash attacks but wears down quickly. The signature attack-type tip.

tips.name: HF
tips.info: Plastic flat tip with a center hole. Lighter and faster than RF, but with less grip and less raw smash power.

tips.name: WB
tips.info: Wide, rounded plastic tip. Excellent stability and balance — a defining defense-type tip.

tips.name: S
tips.info: Pointed plastic tip with minimal contact area. Maximum stamina via low friction, but easily knocked off-balance.

tips.name: WD
tips.info: Wide, rounded tip with a flat base. Solid balance between absorbing attacks and preserving spin.

tips.name: SD
tips.info: Plastic tip between flat and ball. Middle-ground stability and predictable movement.

tips.name: MS
tips.info: Metal version of Sharp. Heavier and more stable than S, with similar low friction for endurance.

tips.name: R2F
tips.info: Refined RF with a sharper edge. More aggressive attack pattern than the original.

tips.name: B
tips.info: Plastic ball-shaped tip. Solid defensive option — narrower contact than Wide Ball but stable.

tips.name: F
tips.info: Plain plastic flat tip. Basic attack movement — predictable and gentler than RF on rebound.

tips.name: BS
tips.info: Ball-end tip transitioning to sharp. Stamina with a touch of balance.

tips.name: HF/S
tips.info: Dual-mode tip — Hole Flat for attack, Sharp for stamina. Swappable between modes.

tips.name: LF
tips.info: Lower-profile flat tip. Pairs with low spin tracks for ultra-aggressive attack builds.

tips.name: D
tips.info: Wide-base defense tip designed for stable, low-friction defensive spin.

tips.name: DS
tips.info: Defense ring around a sharp inner core — defensive shell with stamina-leaning contact.

tips.name: CS
tips.info: Sharp tip with a friction coating — slightly more grip than MS, still stamina-leaning.

tips.name: F:D
tips.info: Mode-change tip from the 4D era. Starts in stamina mode, drops into attack as spin decays.

tips.name: B:D
tips.info: Internal bearings give near-frictionless rotation. The 4D apex stamina tip.

tips.name: X:D
tips.info: Aggressive 4D mode-change tip with an earlier transition for attack reversal.

tips.name: D:D
tips.info: 4D mode-change tip alternating between defense and attack as spin slows.

tips.name: W2D
tips.info: Refined WD with deeper grooves. Better counter-attack against aggressive smash.
